stemMd: At the same temperature and pressure, nitrogen and hydrogen react as N2 + 3 H2 → 2 NH3. What hydrogen volume is required for 4 L of nitrogen, assuming ideal-gas behaviour?
explanationMd: Equal-temperature, equal-pressure gas volumes are proportional to moles. Three volumes of hydrogen react with one of nitrogen, so 4 L requires 12 L.

distractorRationale.b: This introduces an extra factor of two.
distractorRationale.a: This uses the ammonia coefficient instead of hydrogen's.
